name: Forlorn Cavern
summary: In Ironforge's northern depths, the Forlorn Cavern shelters those who keep to the shadows. Thieves, cutpurses, and practitioners of the dark arts conduct business there, far from the Great Forge and the dwarven guards.

sections.title: Ironforge's Shaded Corner
sections.body: Cold and damp, the Forlorn Cavern lies beneath Ironforge's clang of anvils and the Great Forge's heat. Its winding paths follow the northern edge of the underground lake, hidden between the Mystic Ward and the Hall of Explorers. Rogues and warlocks train there, and vendors serve them. Weapon merchants and fishermen work beside the lake as well.

faq.q: Where is the Forlorn Cavern located in Ironforge?
aliases: how to get to forlorn cavern
faq.answer: The cavern lies in northern Ironforge, along the underground lake. Enter from the Mystic Ward to the east, or follow the tunnel west from the Hall of Explorers.

faq.q: Why do rogues and warlocks gather here?
faq.answer: The cavern's natural darkness and seclusion make it a discreet meeting place. Rogue and warlock trainers and merchants who serve both groups can be found there.

faq.q: What shops and services can be found in the Forlorn Cavern?
faq.answer: The cavern has rogue and warlock trainers, Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms for practitioners of dark magic, the Stoneblade weapon shop, and The Traveling Fisherman, an angling supply post.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can find trainers and supplies in this Alliance hub in Khaz Modan. Poisons and specialized blades are sold along its damp stone walkways.
As a warlock, you can train and find supplies at Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms in this secluded part of Ironforge.
